rep.name: Ladder
rep.challenge: Each ring of the ladder has a bar run into its gap. Slide the rungs out (the middle one needs the side ring turned first), then take the ladder down from the top.

rep.name: Knot
rep.challenge: The bar runs into the gap of the right ring, but a ring hooks the bar, so the bar cannot slide (a knot). Turn the bomb ring up into the bar: the blast clears the bar, then the right ring can turn.

rep.name: Aim
rep.challenge: Two rings sit beside the bomb ring. The right one can be freed by turning it; the closed one on the left cannot. Send the bomb left.

rep.name: Long way
rep.challenge: Free the small ring, then turn the bomb ring. The short way runs the bomb into its own pin; go the long way round to the knot.

rep.name: Scales
rep.challenge: Two bars run into the side rings, and each bar is hooked from above, so neither can slide (two knots). Each bomb ring must turn up into its own bar; turned the other way, its bomb hits the center ring instead and the level is lost.

rep.name: Ring road
rep.challenge: Breather: around the road, two rings hold each other and neither can turn. Clear the road up to the bomb ring and send its bomb into the pair.

rep.name: Key
rep.challenge: The blue ring is locked: a tap only shakes it. Free the yellow ring that carries its key, then the blue ring turns.

rep.name: Key bar
rep.challenge: The key of the locked ring is on the bar that runs into the left ring. The right ring is in the bar's way: turn it first, slide the bar out, then the lock opens.

rep.name: Key chain
rep.challenge: Three rings in a triangle: the top one holds the key of the left, the left one the key of the right. Open them in order.

rep.name: Vault
rep.challenge: The bomb ring is locked; its key is on the bar run into the left top ring. The right top ring is in the bar's way, and its pendant must go first. Slide the bar out, then aim the bomb at the closed knot ring, not the free one.
